title: Juliano Cazarré announces seventh child as he turns 46
seoTitle: Juliano Cazarré announces 7th child on 46th birthday
subtitle: Actor announces Letícia Cazarré's pregnancy and asks for help choosing the baby's name
excerpt: Juliano Cazarré celebrated his 46th birthday by announcing his seventh child with Letícia, as the family celebrates Maria Guilhermina's hospital discharge.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Juliano Cazarré turned 46 this Thursday (24) and used the occasion to reveal that he and his wife, Letícia Cazarré, are expecting their seventh child. The news reached the public through an Instagram post, sparking high search interest.

Juliano Cazarré celebrates birthday and announces pregnancy

On his birthday, the actor shared a text mentioning that the "gift is in the oven" and that the baby is expected to arrive in February. The message was accompanied by a photo of the couple, with Letícia placing her hand on her already visible baby bump.

The Cazarré family and their children

Prior to this new pregnancy, the couple already had six children: Vicente (16), Inácio (14), Gaspar (7), Maria Madalena (5), Maria Guilhermina (4), and Estêvão (2). The children's ages were mentioned in Juliano's post.

Letícia Cazarré's pregnancy

Letícia is about four months pregnant, according to the information that the baby is due to be born in February. The couple opened a poll for followers to help choose the boy's name, suggesting the options Sebastião, Bartolomeu, Santiago, and Gregório.

Maria Guilhermina's health challenges

In recent days, the family faced a difficult period when four-year-old Maria Guilhermina was hospitalized for over 20 days due to a severe respiratory infection and complications from Ebstein's anomaly, a rare congenital heart defect. She was discharged on Tuesday (22), and Letícia thanked followers for their support in a story.

Public participation in choosing the name

Juliano invited followers to vote in the poll to choose the baby's name. The options presented were Sebastião, Bartolomeu, Santiago, and Gregório, reinforcing the direct interaction between the couple and the public.

With information from Globo.
